# stdx/sub_assign

> Compound assignment: x -= y, short for x = x - y.

truck [stdx](../stdx.md) · [source](../../../registry/stdx/sub_assign.pkg)

```
let n = 10
n -= 4
print n           // 6
```

The left side can be any place of type `int`: a variable, a field, a
slice element or `*p`. It is evaluated once, so `counts[next()] -= 1`
calls `next` once:

```
let ptr_ = &x
*ptr_ = *ptr_ - y
```

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
{x: place int} -= {y: expr int}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` |  | — |
| `y` | expression | `int` |

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
let {$p} = &{x}
*{$p} = *{$p} - {y}
```
